transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?

My sleep has been completely off for weeks—either I’m up most of the night with my mind going or I crash and still wake up feeling worn out. It's gotten to the point where I just can't keep going like this.
When you can’t sleep, do you feel unusually energetic or need much less sleep than usual without feeling tired, or are you mainly unable to sleep because of stress or worries?

It’s actually a mix of both depending on the night. On some nights, I can get by on just three or four hours of sleep and still wake up feeling totally wired and energetic. Other times, my mind is racing like a motor with worries about my family and bills, and even if I crash, I wake up feeling completely exhausted.

During the nights when you sleep only 3 to 4 hours and still feel wired, do you also have symptoms like feeling unusually euphoric or irritable, talking more than usual, racing thoughts, or doing more risky or goal-driven activities than normal?

Yes, during those times I swing from feeling on top of the world to snapping and yelling, and I'll tear around starting ten projects at once like scrubbing the fridge or reorganizing the pantry. My husband tells me I'm talking a mile a minute, and my thoughts race so fast from one plan to another that I just can't grab hold of them.
Have these high-energy periods lasted for at least 4 days in a row, and during them have they caused problems at work, at home, or led to risky behavior?

Yes, those wired spells have been happening on and off for about three months now, lasting way longer than just four days. It has caused a lot of trouble because I've been written up at my warehouse job for mistakes, my family is constantly tiptoeing around my mood swings, and I've completely stopped going to church and volunteering.
During these high-energy periods, have you ever had hallucinations or believed things that other people said were not true, like feeling specially chosen, having unusual powers, or being watched?

Yes, when I'm in that high gear, I sometimes hear my name called or a man's voice whispering that I'm failing my family, and I'll feel like I have a special gift to fix everything because everyone else is too slow. These voices and thoughts only ever happen during those wired times, and they completely disappear when my mood crashes.
Have you also had periods of at least 2 weeks when you felt very depressed or lost interest in things, with low energy, guilt, or thoughts that life wasn’t worth living?

Yes, those heavy, depressed periods have been hanging over me for about three months now, ever since my daughter's divorce and my mom's health decline. I feel so useless and guilty that I've lost all interest in knitting and volunteering, and there are times I think it would be easier if I just didn't wake up, though I don't have any plans to hurt myself.
Have you ever had the voices, strange beliefs, or feeling watched when you were not in a high-energy or depressed mood, or do they only happen during those mood episodes?
No, those voices only ever happen when I am in that wired, high-energy overdrive state. They completely disappear when my mood crashes into those low, guilty feelings or when I'm feeling normal.
Have you ever had the voices or unusual beliefs when you were not in a high-energy or depressed mood, or do they only happen during those mood episodes?

Those voices only ever happen when I am in that wired, high-energy overdrive state. They disappear completely when my mood crashes or when I'm feeling normal. I've never heard them outside of those intense high periods.
Have you ever had hallucinations or fixed unusual beliefs when you were not in a high-energy or depressed mood, or do they only happen during those mood episodes?

No, those voices only ever happen when I'm in that wired, high-energy overdrive state. They disappear completely when my mood crashes or during other times. I've never had them happen when my mood was stable or normal.
During your depressed periods, have you had thoughts of killing yourself, made any plans, or tried to harm yourself?

During my low points, especially after a bad argument at home or messing up at work, I do sometimes think it would be easier if I just didn't wake up and that my family would be better off without me. However, I have never actually made any plans to hurt myself, and I have never tried to do so.
Have you ever had voices, fixed unusual beliefs, or felt watched when you were not in a high-energy or depressed mood, even for a day or two?
No, not even for a day or two. Those voices only ever happen when I'm in that wired, high-energy overdrive state, and they completely disappear as soon as my mood crashes or during any other time.
During your low, depressed periods, do you ever have the voices or strong beliefs that you are specially gifted or being watched, or do those only happen when you are in the high-energy, wired state?
No, those only happen when I'm in that high-energy, wired state. When my mood crashes and I feel low and guilty, those voices and the feeling of being specially gifted disappear completely.
When you are feeling depressed, do you ever hear voices or have unusual beliefs, or do those symptoms only happen during the high-energy, wired periods?

No, those symptoms only ever happen when I'm in that wired, overdrive state. When I crash into those low, depressed moods, the voices disappear completely and I'm just left with that heavy, guilty feeling.
Have you ever had a period of at least 2 weeks where you felt depressed or lost interest in things and also had the voices or unusual beliefs at the same time?

No, I haven't. Those voices only ever happen when I am in that highly wired, overdrive state. When I crash into those low, depressed periods, the voices disappear completely, so I've never experienced them during my down times.
When the voices or unusual beliefs happen, do they occur only during your high-energy, wired periods, or have they ever continued for at least 2 weeks when your mood was not elevated?

No, they only ever happen when I'm in that high-energy, wired overdrive state. They disappear completely when my mood crashes, and they have never lasted on their own or continued when my mood wasn't elevated.

When you hear the voices or feel specially gifted during the high-energy times, do they seem to match your mood and confidence, or do they ever feel strange, unrelated, or out of place even for that state?

The feeling of having a special gift to fix everything fits right in with my high energy and confidence. However, the voice whispering that I'm failing my family feels really confusing and hurtful because it contradicts that high confidence, even though those voices only ever happen when I'm in that wired state.
When you have the high-energy episodes, do the voices or beliefs mostly match your mood and confidence, or do they ever feel clearly unrelated to how you’re feeling?

The belief that I have a special gift to fix everything fits my high confidence perfectly during those times. However, the voice whispering that I'm failing my family feels completely out of place and scary because it contradicts how on top of the world I feel, even though it only ever happens when I'm in that wired state.

Have you ever had the voices or unusual beliefs continue for at least 2 weeks when you were not feeling unusually high, wired, or depressed? This helps me tell whether the psychotic symptoms only happen during mood episodes or also on their own.

No, they have never happened on their own like that. Those voices only ever show up when I'm in that wired, high-energy overdrive state. Once that ends or my mood goes back to normal, they disappear completely and have never continued on their own.
When the voices or unusual beliefs happen, do they feel completely in line with your elevated mood and confidence, or do they ever seem clearly out of place or unrelated to how you’re feeling?

They only ever happen when I'm in that highly wired state, never when I'm down. It feels a bit confusing and out of place because even though I feel super confident and energized, the voice whispering that I'm failing my family contradicts that confidence. Still, those voices only ever show up on those high-energy nights.

During your low, depressed periods, do you ever have hallucinations or fixed beliefs that you are failing, guilty, or being punished, or do those symptoms only happen when you are in the high-energy, wired state?

Those voices calling my name or whispering that I'm failing only ever happen when I'm in that wired, high-energy state. When I crash into my low, depressed mood, I still feel very guilty and down, but the actual voices disappear completely.
When the voices or unusual beliefs happen, do they feel completely in line with your elevated mood and confidence, or do they ever seem clearly out of place or unrelated to how you’re feeling?

It feels a bit confusing because even though I feel highly confident and convinced I can handle everything, the voice is whispering that I'm failing my family, which feels totally out of place with my high energy. But despite that contradiction, those voices only ever happen when I'm in that wired, high-energy state and never when I'm down.

When the voice says you are failing your family, does it feel like your own thoughts or like an external voice coming from outside your head? This helps me tell whether it is a true hallucination or more like racing thoughts during the high-energy episodes.

It definitely feels like an external voice coming from outside my head, not my own thoughts. It sounds like a man's voice whispering or someone calling my name from the hallway, and it is so real that I actually go to check, only to find everyone else is asleep.
Have you ever had the voices or beliefs continue for at least 2 weeks after the high-energy episode ended, or do they always stop as soon as the mood episode ends?
No, they always stop as soon as that high-energy overdrive ends. As soon as I crash into that low, heavy mood, the voices disappear completely and they never linger.
During your low, depressed periods, do you ever have hallucinations or fixed unusual beliefs, or do those only happen when you are in the high-energy, wired state?

No, those voices only ever happen when I'm in that wired, high-energy overdrive state. When I crash into the low, depressed state, the voices disappear completely, and I'm just left with that heavy, guilty feeling.
When you have the high-energy episodes, do the voices or unusual beliefs mostly match your mood and confidence, or do they ever feel clearly unrelated to how you’re feeling?

Those voices only happen when I'm in that wired, high-energy state and disappear completely when I crash. Even though I feel highly confident and on top of the world during those times, I also feel immense pressure, and the voice whispering that I'm failing my family seems to target that underlying stress of trying to manage everything.
Have you ever had the voices, strange beliefs, or feeling watched when you were not in a high-energy or depressed mood, even for a day or two?

No, I have never had them happen outside of those times, not even for a single day. Those voices only ever show up when I am in that wired, high-energy overdrive state. They disappear completely when my mood crashes or when I'm feeling normal, and I've never experienced them outside of those intense 'up' periods.
Have you ever had hallucinations or fixed unusual beliefs when you were not in a high-energy, wired, or depressed mood, even for a day or two?

No, I have never experienced those voices or any unusual thoughts when my mood is stable or normal. They only ever happen when I am in that highly wired, overdrive state, and they completely disappear when I crash or feel normal.

When you are in the depressed, low-energy periods, do you ever hear voices or have unusual beliefs like feeling guilty in a fixed, unreal way, or do those symptoms only happen during the high-energy, wired periods?

No, those voices only ever happen when I am in that wired, high-energy overdrive state. They disappear completely when I crash into my low, depressed periods, even though I still feel incredibly down and guilty during those times.
Have you ever had the voices or unusual beliefs continue for at least 2 weeks when you were not feeling unusually high, wired, or depressed, or do they always stop when the mood episode ends?

No, they always stop as soon as that high-energy state ends. Those voices only ever happen when I'm in that wired, overdrive state, and they disappear completely when my mood crashes or when things are more stable. They have never lasted on their own outside of those wired periods.

Have you ever had hallucinations or fixed unusual beliefs when you were not feeling unusually high, wired, or depressed, even for a day or two? This helps me tell whether the psychotic symptoms only happen during mood episodes or also on their own.
No, those voices only ever happen when I'm in that wired, overdrive state. They disappear completely when my mood crashes or when I'm feeling normal, and they have never happened on their own.
